# agentai

> `agentai` is a Rust library for building LLM agents on top of the `genai` crate. An `Agent` holds a model configuration, calls the model with the conversation history you pass in, runs tools the model asks for, and deserializes the final answer into any Rust type that implements `serde::Deserialize` and `schemars::JsonSchema`. Runs can be awaited or streamed; you own the history.

Key facts for code generation:

- The crate is pre-1.0 and the API changes between minor versions. This file was written for `agentai` 0.4.0 (schemars 1.x, Rust 1.88+); check the CHANGELOG for later changes.
- The library is async. Examples use `tokio` with `#[tokio::main]` and return `anyhow::Result`.
- Create an agent with `Agent::new(model, system)?` (returns `Result<_, AgentError>`), then optionally `.with_toolbox(toolbox)`. The provider comes from the model name (`gpt-*` OpenAI, `claude-*` Anthropic, ...) or a `provider::` prefix such as `open_router::vendor/model`; the API key from the provider's environment variable (`OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `OPEN_ROUTER_API_KEY`, ...). `Agent` is immutable configuration, cheap to `Clone` and `Send + Sync`.
- Ask with `let result: AgentResult<T> = agent.run(prompt).with_history(&history).await?;` and read `result.answer`. Use `T = String` for plain text. Any other `T` turns on structured output. `AgentResult` also has `new_messages`, `usage` (summed over model calls), `stop_reason`, `reasoning_content` and `iterations`.
- The prompt is any `IntoPrompt`: `&str`, `String` (anything `Into<String>`), a `Media`, or a `Prompt` for vision models: `Prompt::text("What is in this picture?").with_image_url(url)` or `.with_image_bytes("image/png", &bytes)` (sent base64 encoded); `.with_text(..)` and `.with_media(Media)` add more parts in order. `Media::image_url`, `Media::from_url`, `Media::from_bytes`, `Media::from_base64` build media. The model must support images.
- The agent does not remember conversations. Keep a `Vec<Message>` yourself (`Message` has its own stable JSON format), pass it with `.with_history(&history)` and append `result.new_messages` to continue. The system prompt is sent by the agent and is not part of the history. A failed run never changes your history.
- Stream with `agent.run_stream::<T>(prompt).with_history(&history).await?` (same builder as `run`): an `AgentStream<T>` (`Send + 'static`) of `Result<AgentEvent<T>, AgentError>` with `TextDelta`, `ReasoningDelta`, `ToolCall`, `ToolResult` and finally `Finished(AgentResult<T>)`. Read it with `futures_util::StreamExt::next`, write it to stdout, stderr, a file or any `std::io::Write` with `.print_to(std::io::stdout()).await?` (`print_to_async` for `futures::io::AsyncWrite`, `print_to_tokio` for `tokio::io::AsyncWrite`), or pass an `EventListener` (`agentai::listener`; `Printer` is the ready-made one, configurable with `with_*`) to `.listen(..)`, or call `.finish().await`.
- Override the model, toolbox, iteration limit or options for one run: `.with_model(..)`, `.with_toolbox(..)`, `.with_max_iterations(..)`, `.with_chat_options(..)` on the run, or `.with_options(RunOptions)`.
- Configure with `.with_max_iterations(n)` (default 5) and `.with_chat_options(ChatOptions)`. Every setter is `with_*`, getters are bare names. All types are `agentai`'s own (`Message`, `ChatOptions`, `ToolChoice`, `ReasoningEffort`, `Usage`, `StopReason`, `ToolCall`, `Tool`, `LlmError`).
- Errors are typed: a run returns `AgentError` (match on variants, `is_transient()` for retryable provider failures; `MaxTokens { raw }` for an answer cut off by the token limit). Tools return `ToolError`; recoverable ones (`NotFound`, `InvalidArguments`, `Failed`) go back to the model, fatal ones (`Configuration`, `Fatal`) stop the run as `AgentError::Tool`. `ToolError::is_recoverable()` tells them apart.
- Tools are grouped in a `ToolBox`. Write your own with the `#[toolbox]` attribute on an `impl` block and `#[tool]` on its methods. Options: `#[tool(name = "...")]`, `#[tool(strict)]` for strict argument schemas. Combine toolboxes with `ToolBoxSet`.
- Ready toolboxes: `CurrentDateAndTimeToolBox` and `LocationToolBox` (`tools-buildin`), `WebSearchToolBox` and `WebFetchToolBox` (`tools-web`), `McpToolBox` (`mcp-client`) for MCP servers over stdio (`McpToolBox::new`) or Streamable HTTP (`new_http`, `new_http_with_bearer`). All features are on by default.

## Docs

- [Full usage guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AdamStrojek/rust-agentai/master/llms-full.txt): every topic below in one file, with code
- [Crate documentation](https://docs.rs/agentai/latest/agentai/): API reference on docs.rs
- [Agent](https://docs.rs/agentai/latest/agentai/agent/struct.Agent.html): constructors, configuration and `run`
- [AgentRequest](https://docs.rs/agentai/latest/agentai/agent/struct.AgentRequest.html): per-run options and history for `run` and `run_stream`
- [Message](https://docs.rs/agentai/latest/agentai/message/index.html): the conversation history model
- [Prompt](https://docs.rs/agentai/latest/agentai/prompt/index.html): text and images sent in a run
- [Tools and toolboxes](https://docs.rs/agentai/latest/agentai/tool/index.html): `ToolBox`, `ToolBoxSet`, `ToolError`, `ToolResult`
- [`#[toolbox]` macro](https://docs.rs/agentai/latest/agentai/tool/attr.toolbox.html): how methods become tools

## Examples

- [simple.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AdamStrojek/rust-agentai/master/crates/agentai/examples/simple.rs): plain text answers from an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with a follow-up question using the history
- [streaming.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AdamStrojek/rust-agentai/master/crates/agentai/examples/streaming.rs): answer printed as it is streamed, with tool calls
- [event_listener.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AdamStrojek/rust-agentai/master/crates/agentai/examples/event_listener.rs): a configured `Printer` and a custom `EventListener` following streamed runs
- [vision.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AdamStrojek/rust-agentai/master/crates/agentai/examples/vision.rs): the project logo sent to a vision model, by URL and as bytes from the repository
- [struct_output.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AdamStrojek/rust-agentai/master/crates/agentai/examples/struct_output.rs): answer deserialized into a struct
- [tools_custom.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AdamStrojek/rust-agentai/master/crates/agentai/examples/tools_custom.rs): custom tool written with `#[toolbox]`
- [tools_web.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AdamStrojek/rust-agentai/master/crates/agentai/examples/tools_web.rs): Brave web search plus page fetch combined in a `ToolBoxSet`
- [tools_mcp.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AdamStrojek/rust-agentai/master/crates/agentai/examples/tools_mcp.rs): tools from an MCP server started over stdio (`McpToolBox::new_http` connects to a running server instead)
- [openrouter.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AdamStrojek/rust-agentai/master/crates/agentai/examples/openrouter.rs): OpenRouter through the `open_router::` model prefix, with built-in tools
